Do not make skin more orange/saturated, lips lipstick-red, teeth bright white or shadows blacker. New mouth interior/teeth/tongue only where a viseme needs them, kept small and subdued. Keep all non-mouth features unchanged. No text, labels, grid lines or watermark.
visibleQualityLimits: Visemes look distinct in the displayed atlas, but have not been checked at native pixel scale.
